method: Rational shift-and-invert Lanczos on (I + gamma L)^(-1), with one reused sparse Cholesky factorization and projected exp/phi1 scalar functions

references.authors: J. van den Eshof and M. Hochbruck
references.title: Preconditioning Lanczos approximations to the matrix exponential
RD-rational approximations of the matrix exponential

orchestrator_review_2026_11_06: gamma = t/10 follows van den Eshof & Hochbruck (2006). The structural fill-avoidance branch (n >= 50000 and more than 4 lower-triangular nonzeros per row: gamma = t/100 with diagonal incomplete Cholesky preconditioned CG) and the inner-solve tolerance rule were chosen by the implementer on public data only, partly with public timing exploration; no private data or model submissions were used. The stopping multiplier is selected by the benchmark's public calibration rule (calibration_v2/RULE.md).
